description: Na₂VO₃ is Krennerite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.65 Å. V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-52°.
